# PPR August 11 Release

_Category: Uncategorized · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (8/11/2022):

* **Ticket 13265** - An error in the database conversion scripts left 124 vehicle collateral records with a null value in the Model field, which prevented PPR searches against these registrations from completing successfully. These data values have been corrected to prevent further search issues.
